_meta.doc: League entrances keyed by battle event. The epithet describes the venue. Trainers speak from their named pools with the first room line as a fallback. A speaker override can distinguish a title holder from a rival with the same name.
_meta.editing: Keep spoken lines at 110 characters or shorter.

Victory Road.epithet: Snow stays in the grooves cut for eight badges.
lines: Use the wide side of the path. It took a long time for the ice to clear.

E1.epithet: The fresh scorecard hangs just crooked enough to show the old staple holes.
lines: There’s time to check your partner. I’ll do the same.

E2.epithet: The padded door cuts off the intake hall in the middle of a name.
lines: I can hear you now. Ready when you are.

E3.epithet: A voice through the vent finishes announcing the last match.
lines: You’ve been in two rooms where they thought they knew how you’d fight. I’ll try to pay attention.

E4.epithet: Only the floor lamps stay lit. You can see where a hand has worn the paint off the gate.
lines: Leave the gate until we’re done. You’ve got two teams right here to think about.

Champion.epithet: The chair above the ring is empty. Someone left their jacket on it.
lines: They told me to wait up there. I wanted to meet your team down here.

speakers.Blue: I used to count who got here first. Tonight I’m counting who’s still here when we’re done.
